summary: Add --fyi to st conversations send and reply as the same as --kind silent

replay.detail: CLI argument only; no graph replay or projection change.

schema.detail: No database, claim kind or schema registry change. The message stores the existing st3-silent tag.

compatibility.detail: st conversations send and reply accept --fyi, which sends exactly what --kind silent sends; combining it with --kind is refused. The client API is unchanged. Old CLIs reject --fyi. An old peer or old daemon that does not know the silent kind delivers the message as wake and wakes the recipient as today; the CLI warns when no silent receipt confirms holding.
